DON'T DO IT FAM!!!

My friend and I made a reservation for 9 pm. Got there 30 minutes early and were told to go upstairs at 9 pm. That was the only "good part" of this experience. Once upstairs we were bombarded by at least 4 other groups of people waiting to be seated. A server asked us for our name then told us to wait in the corner. He then, at the speed of light, walked past is and 2 other parties and "told" us to follow him. He didn't repeat any names, he didn't look anyone in the eyes, NOTHING!! No one knew what to do. We all assumed we were to follow him and were luckily correct.

We SQUEEZE into the area and are all quiet af because we don't know each other and wait for the server. A different guy comes out with menus, hands everyone one and ask if this is anyone's first time there. One person answer and before anyone could say anything else, the server went to help the person. (This is only important because it was my first time there and the server was shorthanded and distant when I tried to ask for assistance too) He leaves, comes back with water and ask what everyone wants. I wasn't ready so he took everyone's order and then STARES at me until I order something. I find it really weird that this random server took the order and not the person who would be coming but it ain't my job so it ain't my problem!

Another new person, the chef, appeared. He seemed not amused by our table. He said something under his breathe and "began the performance. So, I'm a music teacher. I'm use to loud, unnecessary painful sounds, but the noice at this establishment is TOO MUCH! I was more than happy when it was over.

Each table sits about 9 (which I find weird) but we had 8 people. Throughout the whole dinner each server and the chef seemed completely confused by the empty seat. They placed food there for nooooooo one. The chef also didn't listen to anyone. My friend told the chef multiple times that she only only ordered sushi but he kept giving her food. The chef must have been confused and didn't remember who got what because my friend got another lady's meal. We didn't know this until the end of the meal when the other woman complained about not having everything she ordered. The chef apologized and we paid and gtfo.

The food is basic. Your local Chinese place could give you better for cheaper and with less of a metalic, off beat scrapping, headache creating racket. The seating is trash. I'm a bigger person and saw skinny people having problems with people trying to pass them. The establishment is not well ventilated so smoke fills this place quicker than a hookah bar and barely leaves. There's an elevator right at the front door to take you upstairs (it smells like burning tires though so be careful). That is not a sushi place. Again, THIS IS NOT A SUSHI PLACE!!!!!!!! They have sushi as an option but don't go here thinking you're getting an amazing sushi dinner. This is a performance space for people drunk enough to eat expensive basic chinese food made at the volume of a fork in the garbage disposal by satan screaning at you with 509 crying babies surrounding you like the 9th circle of hell.

You could literally do better anywhere else BUT if you have to go here:

1. Make reservations before hand and get there early
2. Don't order the lemonades unless you want diabetes
3. WATCH YOUR FOOD: if you don't get something you ordered, say something to the chef before he leaves
4. Wear ear plugs!!!!!! Trust me on this. You'll be out of hearing if you don't
5. Order hella water or whatever you're drinking before the server leave CAUSE THEY AIN'T COMING BACK

I'm obviously not going back! It will never be worth it.
